relationships.subject: aging
relationships.evidence_quote: Mechanical allodynia of the hind paw progressively developed with age in both sexes

key_findings: Aged mice of both sexes had mild knee OA, progressive mechanical allodynia and knee hyperalgesia, and increased DRG macrophages and dendritic cells.

DRG chemokine expression showed sex dimorphism: Ccl2/Ccl5 in males, Ccl3/Cxcr4 in females; human DRG CCL2 higher in men and CCL3 higher in women. Aged female DRGs also had increased Trpv1, Scn9a and Scn10a.
